title: A board with polygons of several pours, holes, a dimension and elements that are smashed and locked
how: Counted from the file: 4 layer lines; 2 element lines; 2 signal lines;
routed items are the wires and vias that are direct children of a signal: GND has 2 wires and 1 via, VCC has 1 via, so 4; the polygons are not counted.
The dimension, the holes and the polygons are not read by this reader and add no code.
